policies_and_limits: Shield qualification uses the reached layer tags, not activity mode or all shields. Perk sources and enhancement are captured at attack creation; layer qualification is evaluated at impact.
Only explicitly tagged direct bullet damage consumes this perk shield profile. Explosive perk procs are excluded; complete exotic/split-damage qualification requires calibration.

The consumer queries piercing grant with zero base and takes max(intrinsic extra entities, grant); intrinsic baseline is zero in this reference. Combination with intrinsic/exotic penetration is an explicit unverified content policy.
This ammunition is not anti-Barrier authorization: a zero-multiplier immune layer remains immune. Full Champion guard/stun behavior is not implemented here.

Reference weapon damage, capacity, firing interval, hit region, interpolation shape and shield capacities are synthetic. Range endpoint curves reuse the separately pinned Foundry reference; not all weapon archetypes are calibrated.
Source original currently uses A20/C20. Earlier other-perk captures had row offsets; coordinates were checked rather than copied.
Formal production content registration, UI and complete physical-world restart remain outstanding.
